name: loup-vscode-extension
description: VSCode extension for the Loup programming language (v1.20)
author: Code Craft AI LLC

scripts.package: npm run build && cd packages/extension && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../.vsix/
scripts.test: npm run build && rm -rf .test-out && esbuild packages/*/src/__tests__/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outdir=.test-out --entry-names=[name] --external:vscode-textmate --external:vscode-oniguruma --out-extension:.js=.cjs --log-level=warning && node --test .test-out/*.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/extension && tsc --noEmit -p packages/debug-adapter && tsc --noEmit -p packages/language-server
